# datadog_apm_services (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the APM services reporting traces or universal service monitoring data to Datadog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all APM services reporting in the "prod" environment
data "datadog_apm_services" "prod" {
  filter_env = "prod"
}

# List APM services across all environments
data "datadog_apm_services" "all" {
  filter_env = "*"
}

output "traced_services" {
  value = [for service in data.datadog_apm_services.all.services : service.name if service.is_traced]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter_env` (String) Filter services by environment. Can be set to `*` to return all services across all environments.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (List of Object) List of APM services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `is_traced` (Boolean)
- `is_usm` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
